question: Which one of the following is TRUE about repeating decimals?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Repeating decimals (like 0.333...) can always be expressed in the form of p/q where p, q are integers and q ≠ 0. By definition, any number that can be written as a fraction p/q is a Rational Number. Non-terminating but repeating decimals = Rational Numbers. Non-terminating and non-repeating decimals = Irrational Numbers. **∴ Answer = Always rational**
